# requires: wire
#
# A 302 in front of an ordinary server. Nothing here is exotic; every mirror
# list and every release page is one. It is in the roster because a client that
# does not follow it reports a refusal for a URL that works, and a resume that
# drops its Range across the hop silently restarts the download.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:redirect
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
state A
